ctx.x: Johnny Smith, the guitarist who lives in Colorado. I think he == I don't know where he was originally from, he has a sort of western accent. He's a fine guitarist and of course, Jake Hannah, and they're with Bing here. They open tonight at the Palladium.
He's just got the three guys with him.
